overall_sentiment.instructions: What is the overall customer sentiment? Treat balanced mixed or unclear feedback as neutral.

criteria.neutral: Neutral, ambiguous, or balanced positive and negative feedback
criteria.positive: Predominantly satisfied, enthusiastic, or recommending the product

primary_topic.instructions: Which single product aspect is the main focus or principal reason for the customer feedback? Choose other for feedback outside these aspects or with no clear aspect focus.

criteria.camera: photo and video quality, camera features
criteria.battery: battery life, charging speed and reliability
criteria.display: screen quality, brightness and refresh rate
criteria.performance: speed, responsiveness, gaming and software stability
criteria.value_for_money: price, affordability and value relative to cost
criteria.other: Packaging, delivery, service, unrelated feedback, or no clear product-aspect focus

urgency.instructions: How urgently does this feedback need operational attention? Distinguish strong negative opinion from genuine time sensitivity or safety concerns.
criteria: No immediate action needed; general opinion or praise
Minor inconvenience; can be handled routinely
Meaningful problem; prompt follow-up is appropriate
Time-sensitive or major loss of product function; urgent attention needed
Immediate danger, safety issue, or critical harm

churn_risk.instructions: How much evidence is there that this customer will stop using, return, switch away from, or avoid buying the product again? Do not infer intent to leave from a minor complaint alone.
criteria: No sign of leaving; satisfied or likely to buy again
Minor dissatisfaction without any intent to leave
Uncertain future purchase, regret, or substantial dissatisfaction
Likely to stop using, return, switch, or avoid buying again
Explicit decision to leave, switch brands, or never buy again

escalation_need.instructions: Should a person review this feedback because it describes a safety problem, a severe product failure, unresolved repeated support attempts, or an explicit urgent request? Ordinary praise or a routine minor complaint does not require escalation.

criteria.true: Human attention is justified by a serious or unresolved problem.
criteria.false: Routine feedback can be handled without escalation.

example.name: A strong recommendation
example.text: I love this phone. The camera takes outstanding photos, the screen is bright and clear, and the battery comfortably lasts two days. Excellent value for the price. I would absolutely buy it again.

example.name: Battery frustration
example.text: The battery is terrible and barely survives half a day. Charging takes forever. I regret buying this phone and will switch to another brand.

example.name: A mixed experience
example.text: The battery barely lasts until evening and charging is painfully slow. Performance is smooth and the camera is fantastic for this price, but I would not buy this phone again because of the battery.

example.name: Unclear feedback
example.text: It is a phone. Some days I like it, other days I am not sure. I need more time with it.

example.name: Several product aspects
example.text: The metal frame feels solid and the slim design fits my hand. Gaming is fast and the OLED display looks beautiful, but the photos are blurry at night.

example.name: A customer at risk
example.text: My phone battery swelled and the back casing came apart. I stopped using it. Support has ignored me for a week. I need a replacement immediately and I will never buy from this company again.
